frontmatter.title: AI-Driven Research at Berkeley
frontmatter.author: Audrey Cheng, Shu Liu, Shubham Agarwal, Mert Cemri, Lakshya A Agrawal, Shiyi Cao, Alex Dimakis, Koushik Sen, Matei Zaharia, Ion Stoica, ADRS Team
frontmatter.excerpt: This post provides an overview of recent work from Berkeley on automated discovery using AI. We cover the main solutions and frameworks we've developed so far, along with the problems they are designed to address, and describe how these efforts fit together as part of a broader push toward AI-driven discovery.
